mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build an ADU in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building an ADU varies significantly based on size, complexity, materials, and site conditions. A typical attached or detached ADU in areas like Huntington Beach or Irvine can range from $150,000 to over $300,000. Garage conversions are generally less expensive, often starting around $80,000. These figures are estimates and a detailed quote requires a site assessment and design specifics.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU construction costs in Southern California typically range from $150,000-$300,000+ for new builds, and around $80,000+ for garage conversions. Costs vary by size and complexity.
